answer: A joiner locks 240 spendable POA as nectar inside a hollow vault bolted to a public endorsement trellis of nine rungs. Every 50 minutes a VRF names two established witnesses from disjoint funding graphs; they must co-sign a measurement of a 6 GB memory-hard walk seeded by the epoch and the vault id. A missed window, reused witness, or overlapping stake graph slashes the nectar and burns the vault tag for 18 epochs. Aliases cannot skip rungs or inherit height.
